DML.SELECT: SELECT alarm_id as "id", alarm_config_id as "alarmConfigId", creation_user_id as "creationUserId", recognized_user_id as "recognizedUserId", recognized as "recognized", recognized_comment as "recognizedComments", activation as "activation", activation_comment as "activationComments", deactivation_user_id as "deactivationUserId", deactivation as "deactivation", deactivation_comment as "deactivationComments", filtered_until as "filteredUntil", disagree as "disagree", source_element_type_id as "sourceElementTypeId", source_element_id as "sourceElementId", target_element_type_id as "targetElementTypeId", target_element_id as "targetElementId" FROM rt.alarms
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO rt.alarms (alarm_id, alarm_config_id, creation_user_id, recognized_user_id, recognized, recognized_comment, activation, activation_comment, deactivation_user_id, deactivation, deactivation_comment, filtered_until, disagree, source_element_type_id, source_element_id, target_element_type_id, target_element_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:id , :alarmConfigId , :creationUserId , :recognizedUserId , :recognized , :recognizedComments , :activation , :activationComments , :deactivationUserId , :deactivation , :deactivationComments , :filteredUntil , :disagree , :sourceElementTypeId , :sourceElementId , :targetElementTypeId , :targetElementId , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE rt.alarms SET alarm_config_id = :alarmConfigId, creation_user_id = :creationUserId, recognized_user_id = :recognizedUserId, recognized = :recognized, recognized_comment = :recognizedComments, activation = :activation, activation_comment = :activationComments, deactivation_user_id = :deactivationUserId, deactivation = :deactivation, deactivation_comment = :deactivationComments, filtered_until = :filteredUntil, disagree = :disagree, source_element_type_id = :sourceElementTypeId, source_element_id = :sourceElementId, target_element_type_id = :targetElementTypeId, target_element_id = :targetElementId, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE alarm_id = :id
